info.title: Talent CRM Connect
info.description:
CRM Connect synchronizes candidate information between your Candidate Relationship Management system and LinkedIn Recruiter. With CRM Connect, LinkedIn Recruiter users will be able to export LinkedIn member profiles to your external CRM System and view member profiles directly within the CRM. Users will also be able to view CRM recruiting activity from within LinkedIn Recruiter.

The following features will be available with CRM Connect:

- In-CRM Indicator
    
- One-Click Export
    
- Profile Widget
    
- CRM tab in LinkedIn Recruiter
    

We are making updates to our collections. If you run into any issues pulling the latest changes, simply fork the collection again.

For more details, please check the [Talent CRM Connect Overiew](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/talent/crm-connect/crm-connect-overview)

Sync TCRM Candidates
tags.description:
Candidates should be synced to the Middleware Platform whenever they are created or updated in your Talent CRM connect.

For more details, please see the [Sync Candidate documentation.](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/talent/crm-connect/sync-crm-candidates?context=linkedin/talent/crm-connect/full_context/context)

tags.name: Sync TCRM Pipelines
tags.description:
Pipelines (or the equivalent in your system) should be synced to the Middleware Platform whenever they are created or updated in your Talent CRM Connect. We define a pipeline as any feature that is used for nurturing and sourcing candidates. Other terms for pipeline include talent pool and folder.

For more details, please see the [Sync Pipelines document.](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/talent/crm-connect/sync-crm-pipelines?context=linkedin/talent/crm-connect/full_context/context)

tags.name: Sync TCRM PipelineStages
tags.description:
Pipeline Stages should be sent via the Middleware Platform whenever a new stage is created or an existing stage is updated in your Talent CRM.

For more details, please see the [Sync PipelineStages document](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/talent/crm-connect/sync-crm-pipeline-stages?context=linkedin/talent/crm-connect/full_context/context).

tags.name: Sync TCRM CandidatePipelines
tags.description:
The Candidate Pipeline endpoint represents information about a candidate that is specific to a single pipeline. A candidate’s pipeline information should be synced to the Middleware Platform whenever a candidate is added to, removed from, or updated inside a pipeline in your Talent CRM.

For more details, please see the [Sync CandidatePipelines document.](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/talent/crm-connect/sync-crm-candidate-pipelines?context=linkedin/talent/crm-connect/full_context/context)

tags.name: Sync TCRM CandidatePipelineStages
tags.description:
The Candidate Pipeline Stages endpoint represents information about a candidate that is specific to a single pipeline and stage change. A candidate’s pipeline information should be synced to the Middleware Platform whenever a candidate stage changes inside a pipeline in your Talent CRM.

For more details, please see the [Sync CandidatePipelineStages document.](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/talent/crm-connect/sync-crm-candidate-pipeline-stages?context=linkedin%2Ftalent%2Fcrm-connect%2Ffull_context%2Fcontext)

tags.name: Sync TCRM CandidateResumes
tags.description:
To upload a resume, you first need to get a signed URL from LinkedIn and then use it to upload the file. When uploading resume, LinkedIn recommends to abide by the following considerations:

- Supported media formats are: PDF, DOC, or TXT
- Ensure that the media file size does not exceed 10MB for all file types
- Upload only one resume object per API call
- Ensure that all calls to upload resume use OAuth 2.0 authentication
    

For more details, please see the [Sync CandidateResunes document.](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/talent/crm-connect/sync-crm-candidate-resumes?context=linkedin/talent/crm-connect/full_context/context)

tags.name: Sync TCRM interactions
tags.description:
Interactions include any means by which a candidate has interacted with a recruiter, a candidate has interacted with a company, or a recruiter has updated a candidate’s profile within the Talent CRM system (e.g., recruiter tags and notes). All of the interactions that fall into these categories should be sent via the Middleware Platform whenever they are created or updated in your CRM system.

For more details, please see the [Sync Interactions document.](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/talent/crm-connect/sync-crm-interactions?context=linkedin/talent/crm-connect/full_context/context)

tags.name: Module 3 - Retrieve Exported Candidate
tags.description:
LinkedIn allows the ability for customers to export limited LinkedIn profile information from LinkedIn Recruiter into their Talent CRM with a single click. This integration between LinkedIn Recruiter and the partner Talent CRM will improve workflow improvements for our customers.

For more details, please see the [Retrieve CRM Exported Candidate document.](https://learn.microsoft.com/en-us/linkedin/talent/crm-connect/retrieve-crm-exported-candidates?context=linkedin/talent/crm-connect/full_context/context)
